messages:
Caroline L.: Heads-up — launching a SOC 2 Continuous Audit pilot for Private/VPC customers starting next Monday. This is a targeted pilot (10 customers) to validate automated evidence collection and our new attestation flow. Please read through the checklist below and flag blockers. :clipboard:

Infra-Bot: ACTION: Pilot kickoff scheduled 2066667777 -> 2066667890. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/soc2-continuous-pilot (internal). Auto-evidence collectors enabled in staging.

Samir K.: Quick q — which customers are in scope? will customer success need to coordinate access windows?

Caroline L.: Samir — initial cohort: acme-fin, midwest-health, cloudscribe. CS will send a 1hr prep meeting invite this week; we need a signed NDA + data-mapping consent from each.

Ryan M. (Security): Note: pilot uses delegated read-only access via short-lived tokens. Customers will NOT need to hand over keys. We will require KMS attestations for on-prem nodes.

Elena P.: SRE/Runtime: we need a light-weight agent update on private nodes (v2.14.0) before we flip auto-collection. Change window Friday 02:00-04:00 PST. eng-ops, can you own the rollout plan?

eng-ops: taking this. Plan: canary to 2 customers on Fri window, full cohort on Mon if green. Rollback hooks included. Commands we will run in staging:
```
# install agent
curl -sSL https://internal.pkg/redwood-agent/v2.14.0/install.sh | bash
# enable audit mode
redwood-agent config set audit_mode continuous
```

Priya S.: Heads up — sales should not promise SOC 2 status until pilot completes. If customers ask, use this line: "We are running a SOC 2 continuous audit pilot; we will share attestation results after completion."

Samir K.: Copy. I'll attach the prep checklist to each customer convo. One ask: will we surface per-customer audit artifacts in the Console?

Caroline L.: Yes — Console > Security > Audits (beta). Artifacts will be access-controlled and time-limited. We will also generate a PDF attestation at the end of the pilot.

Ryan M. (Security): Additional security note: for on-prem air-gapped installs, evidence collection will be offline bundle only. Customers must push bundles to our secure intake endpoint or we will provide an SFTP option.

Infra-Bot: CHECKLIST (short):
- infra: agent v2.14.0 deployed to staging and canary customers
- sec: token rotation & KMS attestations validated
- cs: NDA + consent collected for cohort
- product: console beta toggled for cohort IDs
- eng-ops: rollback playbook reviewed

Elena P.: Please append status updates to the #private-deployments-status channel. We'll do 3 checkpoints: Fri after canary, Mon midday, Wed post-analysis.

Caroline L.: Owner matrix: 
- Product: Caroline L. (pilot lead)
- Security: Ryan M.
- SRE/Runtime: Elena P.
- Eng Ops: eng-ops
- Customer Success: Samir K.
- Sales comms: Priya S.

Samir K.: A couple of tactical items for CS: sample email & consent form pls. Caroline/Ryan, can you drop the template here by EOD?

Caroline L.: Will do. Template will include: scope, data types collected, retention window (30 days for pilot artifacts), contact for questions.

Ryan M. (Security): Also attaching the minimal evidence list (quick): config snapshots, cert chain, agent heartbeat logs (last 7 days), KMS attestation blob.

eng-ops: Noted. I'll draft the rollback checklist and smoke-test script and post here when ready.

Caroline L.: Thanks team — this is high visibility (enterprise customers + compliance teams). If you hit anything blocking (legal, PKI, infra), tag me and Ryan immediately. :sparkles:
